text:
liz-product: Following up from today's all-hands — could we get a concise breakdown of why we lost the four Enterprise deals mentioned? Sales wants concrete asks.
sophie-sales: Main ones I heard: pricing, private deployment timeline, and model reliability on 8k context. Is that accurate?
ashley-ceo: Good question. Quick summary: (1) Pricing — competitor offered lower TCO due to better batching/caching; (2) Private — customers need VPC + KMS in 6-8 weeks, we gave 12 weeks timeline; (3) Reliability — a handful of latency spikes on long prompts; (4) Integrations — missing native SSO for some stacks. Will expand in doc.
matt-eng: For reliability, the spike root cause was autoscaling cooldown + cache miss storms. We're shipping a mitigation next week: lower cooldown + kv-prefetch.
miguel-cs: Customer asks: clear SLOs for tail latency and an easy rollback path. Also want a migration playbook.
rebecca-ops: I'll draft a 'private deployment fast-track' checklist — aim to cut delivery time by ~40%.
sophie-sales: Can we get a canonical one-pager for AE to use vs competitor X? Pricing comps + callouts would help.
ashley-ceo: Action items: Liz — own competitor TCO comparison (due 3 business days). Matt — ship cooldown + kv-prefetch patch and write rollout notes (due EOD Friday). Rebecca — draft fast-track checklist (3 business days). Miguel — compile common SLO asks + sample addendum (5 business days). Sophie — collect top 10 customer objections and sample rebuttals (3 business days).
liz-product: Ack. I'll start the TCO table and ping finance for cost assumptions.
matt-eng: Sharing test plan here:
```
- canary 5% traffic
- observe p99 tail for 48h
- rollback if error rate >0.5%
```
:thumbsup:
ops-bot: All-hands followup doc uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/allhands/q1-loss-analysis — edits welcome.
ashley-ceo: Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll review the one-pager in next week's TL sync. If anyone needs headcount help, flag in this thread.
sophie-sales: One more ask from field: a short checklist AEs can run live during calls to address 'we're worried about latency'. I'll draft with Miguel.
miguel-cs: I'll add runbook snippets and an example SLA amendment clause.
